description: Shared by ExchangeContractTest.kt (Android) and ExchangeContractTests.swift (iOS). Body = the two responses joined with U+001E (MultiResponseSource.SEPARATOR): NBP table A (last 15, daily) and table B (last 2, weekly), cut down from the live responses of 5 November 2026 (ZWL hand-added to test the withdrawn-code exclusion). Pair X/USD or X/EUR = PLN rate of X (table B) / PLN rate of the quote from table A of the same effectiveDate, 5 significant digits; change against the previous table B (one week).

endpoints.pairs: combined: ECB daily + NBU list + NBP tables B and A
